runs.ceiling: the pipeline only used 94.7% of the 4 cores it was given, and it needs 95% to count. Kafka hit its memory limit 1,835 times during the window and had to read the backlog back off disk (699,023 page refaults), which is the likely reason. Raise caps.kafkaMemory from 5632m to about 8960m. It shows where scaling stops, and is kept in the table and left out of the ratios.
